sshCaAdminRule.documentation: Rule granting access to the SSH CA administration endpoints (/ssh/admin, /ssh/certs, /ssh/revoke). These endpoints list and revoke every user's certificates, so there is no permissive default: an empty rule (or 0) denies everyone.

sshCaKeyRef.documentation: SSH CA key reference (key ID from LLNG keys)

select.v: Local (CA private key in the LLNG configuration)

sshCaSigner.documentation: Who signs the certificates. 'local' runs ssh-keygen with the private key of sshCaKeyRef. 'openbao' sends every signature to OpenBao's SSH secrets engine, which holds the private key: only keyPublic is then needed in sshCaKeyRef, the plugin refuses to load if the OpenBao parameters are incomplete, and it never falls back to a local key.

sshCaOpenBaoUrl.documentation: OpenBao base URL, e.g. https://bao.example.com:8200 (sshCaSigner = openbao)

sshCaOpenBaoMount.documentation: Mount path of OpenBao's SSH secrets engine

sshCaOpenBaoRole.documentation: OpenBao SSH role used to sign user certificates

sshCaOpenBaoAppRoleMount.documentation: Mount path of OpenBao's AppRole auth method

sshCaOpenBaoSecretId.documentation: AppRole secret_id. Prefer sshCaOpenBaoSecretIdFile or sshCaOpenBaoSecretIdEnv, which keep it out of the LLNG configuration. Exactly one of the three must be set.

sshCaOpenBaoSecretIdFile.documentation: File holding the AppRole secret_id, read at each login, so a rotated secret is picked up without a reload

sshCaOpenBaoSecretIdEnv.documentation: Name of the environment variable holding the AppRole secret_id

sshCaOpenBaoCaFile.documentation: CA bundle used to check OpenBao's TLS certificate (default: system store)

sshCaOpenBaoTimeout.documentation: Timeout of each OpenBao request (seconds). Portal workers block on it: keep it short.

sshCaAllowedKeyTypes.documentation: Allowed SSH key families for signing (comma-separated: ed25519, sk-ed25519, ecdsa, sk-ecdsa, rsa, dss)

sshCaMinKeyBits.documentation: Minimum SSH key size in bits (RSA/DSA only)

sshCaKrlPath.documentation: Path to SSH Key Revocation List file

sshCaSignMaxPerHour.documentation: Maximum /ssh/sign calls per user per hour. 0 disables the limit. Bounds KRL growth: each re-signature of the same key revokes the superseded serial.

sshCaMaxCertsPerUser.documentation: Maximum active (non-revoked, non-expired) certificates per user. 0 disables the limit. Re-signing an existing key replaces its record and is not counted.

sshCaCertHistoryMax.documentation: Superseded certificates kept per user: re-signing a key keeps the old record, marked superseded, for the administration page and sshca-rebuild-krl. The most recently superseded are kept. 0 keeps none.

sshCaCertHistoryRetention.documentation: Days a superseded certificate is kept after it expires.

sshCaKeyRef.es: Referencia de la clave de la CA

sshCaOpenBaoMount.fr: Point de montage du moteur SSH
sshCaOpenBaoMount.es: Punto de montaje del motor SSH
sshCaOpenBaoMount.it: Punto di montaggio del motore SSH

sshCaOpenBaoSecretIdEnv.es: Variable de entorno del secret_id de AppRole

sshCaSignMaxPerHour.fr: Signatures par utilisateur et par heure
sshCaSignMaxPerHour.es: Firmas por usuario y por hora

sshCaCertHistoryRetention.fr: Conservation des certificats remplacés après expiration (jours)
sshCaCertHistoryRetention.es: Conservación de los certificados sustituidos tras su caducidad (días)
sshCaCertHistoryRetention.it: Conservazione dei certificati sostituiti dopo la scadenza (giorni)
